text: そういえば　レッドさんって　マサラタウンの　かた　でしたね　しずかで　よいところと　ききます！

structure.jp: レッドさんって　マサラタウンの　かた　でしたね
structure.en: Red, you're from Pallet Town, weren't you

structure.jp: しずかで　よいところと　ききます！
structure.en: I hear it's a quiet, nice place!

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: よいところと　ききます
patterns.explanation: と before きく shows what it is that you hear. よいところと ききます = 'I hear it's a nice place'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a name is a casual way to bring that person up as what you're talking about. レッドさんって = 'Red, speaking of you'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.span: しずかで　よいところ
patterns.explanation: で after a describing word like しずか joins it to the next one: 'and'. しずかで よいところ = 'a quiet and nice place'.
